description: Profit or loss on a spot crypto trade (coins bought and sold outright, no leverage, no funding) after both fees. Give exactly one of investment (total cash spent, buy fee included) or quantity (coins bought). Each fee is a fraction of that fill's trade value (0.001 = 0.1%): the buy fee is paid on top of the coins' cost, the sell fee comes out of the sale value. For a leveraged perpetual futures position see workflow.run_pnl_planning. Use when user asks "I bought BTC at $X, what is my profit if I sell at $Y?" or "what price do I need to sell at to break even after fees?". Returns: quantity, totalCost, proceeds, totalFees, profit, roiPct and priceChangePct (fractions), priceMultiple, breakevenSellPrice, annualizedReturnPct (a fraction, only when holdingDays is given and is at least 30, null otherwise: annualizing a shorter hold gives meaningless figures).

buyFeePct.description: Buy fee as a fraction of the trade value, 0 to 0.05 (0.001 = 0.1%). Default 0

buyPrice.description: Price paid per coin, in the quote currency (e.g. 60000 for BTC in USD)

holdingDays.description: Optional: days the coins were held; 30 or more also returns the annualized return

investment.description: Total cash spent on the buy, buy fee included (e.g. 1000). Give this or quantity, not both

quantity.description: Number of coins bought (e.g. 0.5). Give this or investment, not both

sellFeePct.description: Sell fee as a fraction of the trade value, 0 to 0.05 (0.001 = 0.1%). Default 0

sellPrice.description: Price per coin at the sale, or the price to test, same currency

name: workflow.run_crypto_profit
title: Crypto Profit
